name: cha
description: Cha 茶: a tea wiki for teas of China and Taiwan, built into one HTML page

scripts.setup: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('data/geojson-map-china')||require('child_process').execSync('git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/longwosion/geojson-map-china.git data/geojson-map-china && cd data/geojson-map-china && git sparse-checkout set geometryCouties',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})"
